camel_example:
aliyun cloudfw ModifyIpsRulesToDefault --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '140.205.118.XXX' --ProxyId 'proxy-nat53f4bbc233234271a1d7' --FirewallType InternetFirewall --Lang zh --RuleType customize --Rules '[
  "uuid_1",
  "uuid_2"
]' --AttackApp PHP
kebab_example:
aliyun cloudfw modify-ips-rules-to-default --source-ip 140.205.118.XXX --lang zh --rule-type customize --rules '[
  "uuid_1",
  "uuid_2"
]' --attack-app PHP --firewall-type InternetFirewall --proxy-id proxy-nat53f4bbc233234271a1d7 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyIpsRulesToDefault

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the requester
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The rule type. Valid values:
basicRule
customize
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。 取值：
basicRule
customize
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en: The list of rules. This parameter is conditionally required: when RuleType is set to customize, you must specify at least one of this parameter or AttackApp. If you specify only RuleType without Rules or AttackApp, the API returns an ErrorParameters error
parameters.help_zh: 规则列表。存在条件必填依赖：当 RuleType 为 customize 时，本参数与 AttackApp 至少须提供一个；仅传 RuleType 而不传 Rules 或 AttackApp 时，API 返回ErrorParameters
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en:
The Cloud Firewall type. Valid values:
VpcFirewall: virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall
InternetFirewall (default): the Internet firewall
parameters.help_zh:
云防火墙类型。取值：
VpcFirewall：表示VPC边界防火墙。
InternetFirewall（默认）：表示互联网边界防火墙
parameters.name: firewall_type

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the NAT firewall instance. This parameter is required only when FirewallType is set to NatFirewall. In this case, the scope is the rules under this instance. This parameter is ignored for Internet and VPC firewalls. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2879296.html operation to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: NAT防火墙实例ID。仅当 FirewallType 取值为 NatFirewall 时必填，此时作用域为该实例下的规则；互联网/VPC边界分支会忽略本参数。您可以通过调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2879296.html 接口查询
parameters.name: proxy_id
